findings.problem: 3.7a applies one helper to both `/s/unknown` and `/embed/yt/dQw4w9WgXcQ`, and its Inputs describe 2.1a's single `/(s|embed)/:path*` header set. G8's 3.4b split that source inside `src/lib/security/csp.ts`: `/s/:path*` → `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `frame-ancestors *`; `/embed/:path*` → `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin` (the hosted page exists to supply a referer), `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`, no `X-Frame-Options`, and no `frame-ancestors` directive at all. As written the smoke test fails on the embed page and the Inputs mislead the agent.
findings.fix: Split the helper: `expectShareHeaders` (for `/s/*`: CSP contains `frame-ancestors *`, `x-robots-tag` contains `noindex`, `referrer-policy: no-referrer`, `cache-control` contains `no-store`, no `x-frame-options`) and `expectEmbedHeaders` (for `/embed/*`: `x-robots-tag` contains `noindex`, `referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, no `x-frame-options`, CSP does NOT contain `frame-ancestors 'none'`). Use `expectEmbedHeaders` in Build 4.4, 4.5 and 4.7 and in done_when for `/embed/yt/dQw4w9WgXcQ`. Rewrite the Inputs bullet: 'header sets are built in `apps/web/src/lib/security/csp.ts` (2.1a, split by 3.4b into `/s/:path*` and `/embed/:path*`) and applied from `next.config.ts` — read `csp.ts` and `csp.test.ts` for the exact values'. Apply the same split in 3.9's helper item 1 (`/embed/yt/…` → 200, `x-robots-tag: noindex`, `referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`).

findings.quote: `cleanupRun(tag)` → deletes `organizations` whose `slug` starts with the tag (cascade removes settings, memberships, sermons, share links
findings.problem: DESIGN §4 conventions: '**Hard org deletion is forbidden** (super admin sets `cancelled`; a cron purges after 30 days with the service role); child FKs that must not cascade use `on delete no action`' and the §6 policy table lists organizations delete as '— (never; `cancelled` + purge)'. `persons.household_id` and `surveys.audience_group_id` are `on delete no action`, so a bare cascade may also fail. The prompt presents the hard delete as routine.
findings.fix: Rewrite Build 3: 'Cleanup is a deliberate, test-runner-only exception to DESIGN §4 "hard org deletion is forbidden" — say so in `docs/QA_WEB.md` and HANDOFF "Deviations from plan". Implement it as the same purge `srv_housekeeping()` performs for `cancelled` orgs: with the secret key set the org `status = cancelled`, then delete children in FK order (persons before households; surveys before audience_groups; then the org row), and enqueue/ignore storage objects as documented. Never touch rows whose slug lacks the run tag.' Keep the `example.invalid` auth-user deletion.
